integrity: Proof is analytic; CHECK.py independently evaluates finite Fourier fibers and periodic approximations. Numerical checks are not infinite proof. No independent audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements require the normalized one-dimensional lattice Laplacian, the symmetric two-band spectral notch \(0<c<1\), two unweighted even-site samples at times 0 and t>0, and noiseless data. Optimality of the sampling time is asymptotic as c decreases to zero; no uniqueness of each finite-c optimizer is claimed. General m-channel frame criteria and the spectral-collision obstruction are prior literature. Full text of one closely motivating 2026 paper was not accessible, leaving publication-priority risk.
title: Exact two-time diffusion frame bounds and optimal blind-spot scaling on the integer line
